Experienced in delivery management, workforce planning, vendor governance, risk management, compliance oversight, executive stakeholder engagement and organizational growth.

raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES Program Management | Operations & Delivery Management | Business Transformation | GCC Operations | Shared Services | Stakeholder Management | Vendor Governance | Workforce Planning | Operational Excellence | SLA & KPI Management | Risk & Compliance | Change Management | Service Delivery | Escalation Management | Resource Planning | Analytics & Reporting | Team Leadership | Employee Engagement
CAREER HIGHLIGHTS • 13+ years of leadership experience across Operations, Delivery Management and
Investment Banking Operations.
Scaled operations from 20 to 100+ employees through strategic workforce planning and
delivery governance.
Established and launched a new Hyderabad delivery center supporting global
operations.
Managed enterprise operations supporting Goldman Sachs with accountability for SLA,
quality, productivity, compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Led executive governance forums with Managing Directors and global stakeholders. • Successfully supported the transition from Staff Augmentation to Managed Services delivery model.
Built, mentored, and retained high-performing teams while driving
employee engagement initiatives.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Program Manager | Apexon | Nov 2022 – Apr 2026 • Led a 100+ member multi-location team supporting Goldman Sachs Investment
Banking operations, managing Client Lifecycle Management (CLM), KYC, and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) processes while consistently delivering SLA, quality, productivity, and regulatory compliance targets.
Established the Hyderabad delivery center and scaled operations from 20 to 100+ employees, ensuring seamless business continuity and governance.
Maintained 98.9% productivity and 99% accuracy by strengthening operational controls, compliance, and quality standards.
Led governance forums with client leadership, managed critical escalations, and improved Vendor NPS from 70% to 95%.
Successfully transitioned the engagement from Staff Augmentation to a Managed Services model by redesigning workflows, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Managed workforce planning, performance management, coaching, succession planning, and talent development for a 100+ member team
Team Leader | J.P. Morgan | Jul 2010 – Oct 2021
Managed multiple investment banking operations functions including Research Fee
Billing, Client Setup, OTC Clearing Onboarding, Front Office Limits and Wholesale Loan Services.
Ensured regulatory compliance, operational accuracy and audit readiness across critical
business processes.
Supported global trading operations through pre-trade limit setup and controls
management.
Led migration initiatives and contributed to governance standardization and operating
model improvements.
Managed MIS reporting, SLA monitoring, capacity planning and business analytics for
leadership reviews.
Mentored new hires and delivered functional training programs to strengthen team
capability and performance.
Assistant Accountant | Laboratory Traders | 2008 – 2010 • Managed accounts payable, statutory compliance, payroll, reconciliations, and financial
reporting.
Supported month-end and year-end financial closing activities while maintaining
accounting accuracy.
